# Cannot compute: CN code missing

The ruleset requires three inputs, and one is missing.

| Required input | Provided? |
|---|---|
| (a) CN code of the good | ❌ "Steel goods" is not a CN code |
| (b) Country of production | ✅ India |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | ✅ 3,000 t |

Default SEE values are selected by both CN code and country. "Steel goods" could match several entries in the table, and their factors for India differ substantially. Under the rules, I can't pick one or estimate.

## India default values in the table

| CN code | Good | SEE (tCO2e/t) | Result if 3,000 t |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 2.64 | 7,920.00 tCO2e |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 4.32 | 12,960.00 tCO2e |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, iron/non-alloy steel, with indentations… | 4.27 | 12,810.00 tCO2e |
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen (iron, not steel) | 2.53 | 7,590.00 tCO2e |

These are reference values only, not a declared result. Depending on the code, the outcome ranges from 7,590.00 to 12,960.00 tCO2e.

## What's needed
Please give the 8-digit CN code of the goods produced. If the 3,000 t covers more than one product type, give the tonnage for each CN code. I'll then calculate the embedded emissions as SEE × quantity, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
